levels.description: Slashes the nearest enemy <@ba.vup>10</> times, each slash dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage; if the target is defeated, retargets to the next nearest enemy and adds <@ba.vup>+1</> to remaining slash count; once all slashes end, if target has not been defeated and is on a deployable tile, <$ba.addash>Move</> to said tile, otherwise return to starting tile; afterward, ATK <@ba.vup>+{chen3_s2[respawn_buff].atk:0%}</> and gains <@ba.vup>{chen3_s2[respawn_buff].prob:0%}</> Physical and Arts Dodge
